diversity_review: Twelve distinct settings covering all eight task types and all eight domains; tested operations vary (deadline, date exclusion, schedule against working hours, weather condition, time cut-off with day arithmetic, age band and payment channel, location by hours, step order with an emergency condition, eligibility and calling window, per-street schedule, temporary procedure with limit and exception, ordering cut-off with age-based fee). No slug reuse and no re-skin of a catalogue item; nearest neighbours (p4 job ad, p1/batch003-kantine pay-at-pick-up, batch003-lift maintenance notice) differ in text type, structure and rule tested, and the blueprint's needed-topics list asks for exactly these settings. Four settings recur in the parallel listening batch 005 (telefoonwinkel, apotheek with mevrouw Bakker, gemeente parkeervergunning with the same slug in another part, city bus with the pin-only rule); allowed across parts, but mixed drills should not pair them. Neighbourhood topics appear twice; personas recur (Fatima and Roos in five items each), which mock forms should not place in consecutive texts.
limitations: This is an AI editorial review. It does not replace independent Dutch-language educator review, learner trials, blueprint validation or psychometric calibration, and it does not establish equivalence with the official DUO exam. The A2 label remains an unvalidated authoring target.
